title: unagi-kc-audit: dual-spectrum audit code for GRN-prior injection in single-cell VAEs
description:
Analysis and audit code supporting the manuscript Gene-regulatory priors do not reach the loss: a dual-spectrum audit of single-cell variational autoencoders.

Contents: the released kappa_c_audit toolkit, whose fourth check tests whether an injected prior reaches the training objective; the figure generators for every figure in the paper; the derived result files behind each reported number; the audit records documenting how each number was verified; and the manuscript sources.

The raw training artefacts (39 GB of stagedata) are not included: they are derived from public data (GEO GSE150774, GSE136831, GSE153162) and are regenerated by the released code.
